title: REQ · Gold + SUGGEST WHAT HAPPENS NEXT header button opens the contribution dialog
summary: The suggest button lives in the header, is gold, and opens the existing dialog.
description: Context: the Suggest button is a frame button in App.tsx scene slot with triggerRef. Desired behavior: move it into HeaderOverlay as a gold button labelled + SUGGEST WHAT HAPPENS NEXT, keeping the accessible name Suggest What Happens Next and focus return. Expected result: one suggest button, in the header; App no longer renders the old one. Why: matches the reference and removes the replaced path.
acceptance_criteria: Given the header with onSuggest, when the player clicks the button named Suggest What Happens Next, then onSuggest is called once.
Given App after Begin, when the player clicks that button, then the contribution dialog opens and exactly one such button exists.
Given the dialog closes, when Escape is pressed, then focus returns to the header button.

in_scope: App wiring and removal of the old button

technical_constraints: Keep contribution flow and Go API contracts.
